mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_key, admin_only, execution_type, execution_key, system_prompt, enabled_plugins, enabled_tools, magic_params, image_history_mode, model_provider_key, model_name, model_temperature, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_config WHERE agent_key = #{agentKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_config SET magic_params = JSON_SET( COALESCE(NULLIF(magic_params, ''), JSON_OBJECT()), '$.budget', IF( JSON_EXTRACT(NULLIF(magic_params, ''), '$.budget') IS NULL, JSON_EXTRACT(CAST(#{defaults} AS JSON), '$.budget'), JSON_EXTRACT(NULLIF(magic_params, ''), '$.budget')), '$.memory', IF( JSON_EXTRACT(NULLIF(magic_params, ''), '$.memory') IS NULL, JSON_EXTRACT(CAST(#{defaults} AS JSON), '$.memory'), JSON_EXTRACT(NULLIF(magic_params, ''), '$.memory')), '$.memory.maxToolPairsPerTurn', IF( JSON_EXTRACT(NULLIF(magic_params, ''), '$.memory.maxToolPairsPerTurn') IS NULL, JSON_EXTRACT(CAST(#{defaults} AS JSON), '$.memory.maxToolPairsPerTurn'), JSON_EXTRACT(NULLIF(magic_params, ''), '$.memory.maxToolPairsPerTurn'))) WHERE agent_key IN ('general', 'with_time', 'time_workflow', 'system_admin') AND ( magic_params IS NULL OR magic_params = '' OR JSON_EXTRACT(magic_params, '$.budget') IS NULL OR JSON_EXTRACT(magic_params, '$.memory') IS NULL OR JSON_EXTRACT(magic_params, '$.memory.maxToolPairsPerTurn') IS NULL )
